topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I don’t know how to face them now, knowing what I do. We’ve shared so much, kept each other’s secrets, supported each other through thick and thin. Now, this divides us, this space between what they told me and the truth I stumbled upon. Every time I think about all the conversations, the stories of their work that now ring hollow, my heart just... aches. I want to believe in them, in us, but it’s hard to look at them the same way again. How do you go back from something like this?
